faq_list.question: Which channels will campaign videos be uploaded to?
faq_list.answer: Videos are uploaded to your preferred channel: Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube.

faq_list.question: Can I request revisions?
faq_list.answer: One free revision is available for minor edits such as captions or fonts, excluding reshoots.

faq_list.question: What types of brands is MYIN best suited for?
faq_list.answer: Ideal for brands looking to naturally reach local consumers through Southeast Asian influencers.
